assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: wide photographic background for the expanded Home panel of a macOS notch app. Primary request: a realistic cozy autumn cabin scene, holiday-neutral Fall theme. One continuous photograph, panoramic 4:1 composition. Real wood cabin interior, soft warm amber afternoon light, windows looking onto golden maple foliage. Left 70 percent quiet, dark walnut wood and subdued cabin window surfaces, negative space suitable for white music and calendar text. Rightmost 25 percent showcase a beautiful natural branch arrangement of red, copper and golden maple leaves on a wooden table beside the window; prominent and fully visible within the shallow panorama with generous top and bottom breathing room. Natural leaf veins and worn wood grain, credible real-world photographic texture, not a render. Consistent premium cozy photographic feel with other seasonal cabin themes. No people, no text, no UI, no borders, no separate inset photographs, no pumpkins or jack-o-lanterns, no Halloween symbols, no Christmas ornaments or decorations, no artificial neon.

No people, text, UI, borders, collage, inset photo, no Christmas lights, ornaments, stockings, presents, Santa, wreaths, stars on trees, red-green festive decorations, no religious imagery, no cartoon or CGI look.
